about: A live run of T10-study-planner, recorded for replay.

features.name: Schedule evening study
features.request: My exam is in two weeks... I study evenings

features.name: Flashcards from notes (later)
features.request: Later I'll paste notes to make flashcards

value.name: Exam study planner
value.summary: Add your exam topics and they are spread over your evening study sessions from today until the exam, never on the weekdays you rule out (Friday is set). Tick sessions off as you go.
